messages.subject: format axis label
parts:
Hi ggplot2 users,

I tried to change the size of y label, but when add axis.title.y = element_text(size=10) in theme(), it does not show y label at all. Before I add this line of code, it has the label. What is the problem? Thanks.

messages.author: 98fc74ba56643c44
messages.subject: Re: format axis label
parts:
On 11 Aug 2016, at 14:11, lily li wrote:

Hi ggplot2 users,
I tried to change the size of y label, but when add axis.title.y =
element_text(size=10) in theme(), it does not show y label at all. Before I
add this line of code, it has the label. What is the problem? Thanks.

Hi Lily,

I just tried that exact code:

...
theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
...

in a ggplot2 plot and it worked for me, so it's likely that something else specific to your code is the issue (or perhaps that you're not running the latest ggplot2 version).

If you're sure you have the latest stable version of ggplot2, please provide a reproducible example. That would help the list help you.

Best,

Sherif
